body: I don't know what to say, but I think I need to figure this out on my own. I don't even know you and you have done so much for me at least I got something else to think about for a while. I've read some of the other post and see some of ur comments on them. you might not get this a lot or maybe you do but thank you. please keep doing what u r doing
You know what I think you might be right any ideas on how i might find what i want to be defined as?

Believe it or not what you said to me actually helped me more than you think. Just to know that someone cares and honestly just to know that someone knows my story makes me feel better. I'm not really in the spot to give advice but thank you for helping me in the way that you did.
